run_simple_rollout: run simple_rollout to send a single inference request per document and return the result
run_chunked_rollout: run chunked_rollout to split long inputs into chunks and stitch model generations together
run_heavy_cpu_rollout: run heavy_cpu_rollout to offload heavy preprocessing to a process pool before generating
build_inference_pipeline: build an inference pipeline with InferenceRunner, chunked rollouts, and JsonlWriter output
deploy_slurm_executor: deploy SlurmPipelineExecutor for distributed inference across multiple GPU nodes
